## s16-v08 — argument map

In crisis or at peace, weeping or laughing, deep or distracted (viṣamastho'pi svastho'pi rudannapi hasannapi gambhīro'pi vicitto'pi). May I be, by devotion (bhaveyaṃ bhaktitaḥ prabho).

### Open
- Swamiji (Academy, ch16 v8): 'Let me be ... in crisis or peaceful, or miserable or happy ... by the intensity of Thy devotion ... I don't mind.'
